top_choice_rationale: Palladium-catalyzed C-N cross-coupling for Buchwald and Hartwig is fully mature, structurally and kinetically supported (hard amido-palladium reductive elimination needed its own ligand design, distinct from the 2010 C-C prize), and has the cleanest two-name attribution with no decisive contributor omitted. P001 (protein degradation) is the more novel principle but is ahead of any approved degrader and the three-name limit omits Ciulli, Sakamoto, Kim and Gray; P003 (sequencing by synthesis) is mature but its chemistry-versus-platform scope and Rothberg/Mayer/Ju credit are contested; no award is worse than any of these.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Stockholm University colleague of Secretary Peter Brzezinski, who is not a candidate
